protocol.scope: Recorded feed parameter cases plus prespecified stress regimes. All statistics are from Solidity execution. Antithetic variance reduction is established prior art, not a claimed new theorem. No pricing-measure or market-accuracy claim.

method: 256 prespecified Solidity seed replications per case. Joint-seed bootstrap with 2000 resamples for pointwise 95% intervals. Variance-times-gas compares three-strike batches, not scalar calls. Standard errors concern sampling only. No simultaneous-coverage or market-accuracy claim.
